replies.text: Credential vaults are usually the part agent demos skip. Good to see them treated as a real topic next to guardrails and memory.
The canvas built by a plugin is the interesting part. An agent that can draw its own view beats another chat panel.
A diff sheet for every tool call is the right choice on a phone. Small screen plus silent edits is a bad combination.
Deleting production data without a second look. I would put force-pushing to main right next to it.
